name: kavach
description: Kavach — campus safety, emergency response and student wellbeing system for BIT Sindri

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix student install && npm --prefix admin install && node scripts/setup-env.js
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,student,admin -c red,blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix student run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix student run build && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n api,student,admin -c red,blue,green "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix student run preview" "npm --prefix admin run preview"
